status: STOP_AND_DISCUSS — the capture rate condition the owner set has been met
headline: The 15000-20000 target is not achievable under the current licence discipline. The binding constraint is not effort, sources or engineering. Most coffee sensory literature is not openly licensed.

incumbent_families_run_to_exhaustion.interpretation: Europe PMC, OpenAlex, Zenodo and Dryad together exhaust at roughly 4000 unique licence-clear relevant records, not 8000.

jstage.interpretation: J-Stage reports 24274 records for the Japanese term for coffee, but their DOIs overwhelmingly fail to resolve to an open licence. Japanese academic publishing is largely not CC-licensed.

core.note: 50% request error rate at this cadence.

revised_ceiling_estimate.core: 1000-2000 with sustained effort against a 23% resolution rate and heavy request errors
revised_ceiling_estimate.critical_caveat: This is BEFORE cross-family DOI deduplication. OpenAlex aggregates Crossref, PMC and DOAJ; CORE aggregates repositories that also feed OpenAlex. Unique yield will be lower, possibly materially lower. Not yet measured.
revised_ceiling_estimate.against_owner_target: 15000-20000 is roughly 2.5x to 3x above the measured ceiling.

operator_error_corrected.claim: The operator's own source_expansion_assessment rated 15000-20000 as PLAUSIBLE with the added families.
operator_error_corrected.cause: That estimate was built from hit counts — J-Stage 24274, CORE 648444, Zenodo 31644 — without measuring licence-resolution rates. Hit count is an addressable pool, not extractable yield.
operator_error_corrected.significance: This is the same error class the operator documented in R12C-F2 and criticised in R10 and R11: treating an addressable pool as if it were yield. The operator repeated it.

implication_for_anfis.owner_premise: 15000-20000 was described as suitable for ANFIS and subsequent training.
problems: A discovery candidate is not a training sample. R11 converted 248 candidates into 3 admitted candidates and 10 coffee groups.
Post-R12C-repair conversion is unmeasured. No extraction has been run against the repaired gates at scale.
ANFIS requires substantial labelled data. The measured constraint chain runs capture -> extraction -> admission -> supervision groups, and only the first link has been repaired.
implication_for_anfis.recommendation: Do not set the ANFIS decision against a capture number. Measure the capture-to-supervision conversion rate on the 4019 already captured before committing to any target.

options_for_owner.action: Accept roughly 7000 as the ceiling and proceed to extraction
options_for_owner.note: Measures the real bottleneck, which is conversion rather than capture.

options_for_owner.action: Relax licence discipline to admit unresolved-licence records
options_for_owner.cost: Recreates the 13952 unresolved-rights records R10 tested and excluded; destroys the project's defensibility

options_for_owner.action: Request data directly from corresponding authors
options_for_owner.note: Standard practice; reaches material that is not openly licensed.
The literature's data exists because someone ran a panel.
